test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(**Note**: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) GD - FI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7982ee9dcfe6dbe4e2bb049c3e1fb771c1628f6148ec17b3331fafd8fec870e2.png] 

Option 2) JG - IM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a890ddc0b75c34db2e5de0d8f15f3e79fd3cae3396766cf690006535c876555c.png] 

Option 3) NK - MP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbc17602cd9a93f5dc7dce0c29c1b2d85b7cdfeda9ed8faaabd9b20d209d6dc2.png] 

Option 4) DA - CF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a905c9a00a86a619b21c6bc60b59dcae76f97cc32ce7643489c12937c029779e.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'JG - IM' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer
